lines.zh: 沙子从我的肋骨间漏下。
lines.en: Sand sifts between my ribs.
I'm not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 四个蹄子踏着骨头的声音。
lines.en: Four hooves clicking like dry bone.

lines.zh: 我背上的骑手一言不发。
lines.en: The rider on my back says nothing.
Night sand is cold; my legs colder.
I walk along the moon's shadow.
Dry sand crumbles under my steps.

lines.zh: 我驮着两个不会呼吸的东西。
lines.en: I carry two things that don't breathe.

lines.zh: 队伍早就没了，只剩我们。
lines.en: The caravan's gone; only we remain.
My shadow is longer than a camel's.
Wind passes through my hollow chest.

lines.zh: 一步一步，往村子的废墟去。
lines.en: Step by step, toward the ruined village.
I need no food and no water.
I stand like a dead tree.
There's no light in my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 沙子在我背脊上积成一层。
lines.en: Sand collects along my spine.
I don't breathe; I only listen to wind.
My hide clings tight to bone.

lines.zh: 太阳出来时我躲进阴影。
lines.en: When the sun rises I hide in shade.
Something gnaws at my old saddle.
I can't recall an oasis anymore.
Time means nothing to me.
You still have warmth about you.
I tilt my skull and watch you long.
A living one came close. How nice.
Your heartbeat is far too loud.
I smell the blood beneath your skin.
Were you left behind as well?
Only two dark pits in my eyes.
I turn my head toward you, slowly.
You shouldn't be out at night.
My rider is watching you too.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是少了块骨头。
lines.en: I don't hurt; I just lost a bone.
Sand leaks out of the crack.
You scattered my ribs.
I am standing again.
That's not enough to break me.
My rider steadies me.
I hear my own bones rattle.
Pain? I've forgotten what it is.
You broke my stride.
Sand fills the wound back up.
Food? My stomach rotted long ago.
You hold out grass; I don't eat.
I can no longer smell hunger.
Don't wave carrots at me.
That smell is from very long ago.
I follow you, and not for food.
Put that away, will you.
My teeth can't grind grass now.
Keep the food of the living.
I only want the warmth in you.
Bumping me must hurt; I'm all bone.
This body doesn't step aside.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我闻到活气。
lines.en: Too close; I smell life on you.
My ribcage is hard as stone.
Sand crunches under us both.

lines.zh: 我从你身边擦过去，很慢。
lines.en: I brush past you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 别碰我的鞍，那是骑手的。
lines.en: Don't touch my saddle; it's my rider's.
Back off; my legs feel nothing.
My bones are creaking again.
You're the one who yields, not me.

lines.zh: 这种东西早就不属于我了。
lines.en: That no longer belongs to me.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没有第二头我这样的。
lines.en: No second one like me in this desert.

lines.zh: 我连自己的影子都不靠近。
lines.en: I don't even come near my own shadow.
Bone against bone only breaks.

lines.zh: 我记得有过同伴，然后没了。
lines.en: I recall companions, then nothing.
Don't do that; I'm already dead.
I stand and watch the moon rise.
Many years lie between us now.
There will be no calf from me.
The dune is empty. Good.
I pick up what my rider dropped.
Whose bone is this one?
I carry a scrap of old rein.
Half an iron shard, buried in sand.
Useless, but I'll take it.
My teeth clamp down hard.
My rider wants this carried along.
I hook it to the saddle.
Who dropped this? It can join the bones.
I lower my skull and lift it slowly.

lines.zh: 有活物，就在那边的沙丘。
lines.en: A living thing, on that dune.
My rider raises the spear.
That warmth won't escape now.
I turn, my snout aimed at you.
The wind carries the scent over.
The bones remember how to chase.
I can see torchlight.
Someone broke the crest of the sand.
The passenger on my back stirs.
At last, something to chase tonight.
I want to hear a living voice.
That shadow moves; it's real.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝一个方向。
lines.en: My head stays fixed one way.
Something under the sand is warm.

lines.zh: 我的骑手把矛尖压低了一寸。
lines.en: My rider lowers the spear tip by an inch.
I approach step by step, unhurried.
I have watched you a long while.
I open my jaw; no sound comes.

lines.zh: 你的火光在我的眼窝里。
lines.en: Your torchlight fills my eye sockets.
I don't chase; I wait for you to tire.
My hoofprints circle around you.
The wind stopped, and you can't run.
I lower my neck as if to butt.
The spear tip behind me glints.
Step back again and it's quicksand.
Sand clings to my jaw.

lines.zh: 我一直没眨眼，因为没有眼。
lines.en: I never blink; I have no eyes.
Your breathing is getting ragged.
I stop before you and go still.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，蹄子陷进沙里。
lines.en: I shift step by step, hooves sinking into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子先伸出去探你。
lines.en: My long neck reaches out to test you first.

lines.zh: 你想绕到我侧面，那有骑手的矛。
lines.en: Circle to my flank and you meet the rider's spear.

lines.zh: 我站在上风口，让你闻骨头味。
lines.en: I stand upwind so you smell old bone.
My front hoof slams down.
My rider's spear arrives first.
I ram your chest with my skull.

lines.zh: 这一下带着几百年的力气。
lines.en: That blow carries centuries of strength.
Sand sprays up and covers you.
I clamp onto your sleeve.
My teeth are black as tar.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头撞骨头了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear bone strike bone?
My kick is slow but heavy.
The rider laughs on my back.
The sand will catch you when you fall.
I raise my hoof once more.
This bite caught only wind.
Your blood is warm. How strange.

lines.zh: 我猛地一甩头，撞在你肩上。
lines.en: I snap my head around and catch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 骑手的矛扎进了你的甲缝。
lines.en: The rider's spear finds the seam in your armor.
I pull myself out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我的骨头先出来，皮后出来。
lines.en: Bones first, hide after.

lines.zh: 一个尸壳爬上了我的背。
lines.en: A husk climbs onto my back.
Another passenger settles into place.

lines.zh: 沙丘下埋着的都被叫醒了。
lines.en: Whatever was buried wakes up.
My first breath was sand.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我黑褐色的皮。
lines.en: Moonlight on my black-brown hide.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己躺了多久。
lines.en: I don't know how long I lay.
The reins slip onto my head themselves.

lines.zh: 沙子退开，让出我的位置。
lines.en: The sand recedes to make me room.
I stand; my knees creak.
Lights still burn in the distant village.
My rider plants the spear in sand.
The three of us gaze into the night.
Fire; my hide shrinks. I don't cry out.

lines.zh: 从沙脊上摔下去，骨头散了。
lines.en: Fell from the ridge; bones scattered.
Water fills my hollow chest, heavy.
The blast lit up all the sand.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肋骨间。
lines.en: An arrow lodged between my ribs.
Light passes through me like an empty shell.
I stopped being hungry long ago.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我闻到自己烧焦。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I smell myself scorching.
Below there is no sand, only black.
